body.p: (task 0.7). Reference counts are not atomic and the name pool, registry and lazy indexes mutate on read. Rule: an item heap and everything tied to it (its name pool, type registry, trees and values) are used by one thread at a time; separate heaps are fully independent. Static const data and functions on inline values are safe from any thread. Sharing one parsed document between threads is not supported in year one; if needed later it becomes a new decision (an immortal, frozen tree with a read-only name pool is the likely shape).
